Overrides the height of the composition.

## CLI flag

Use `--height` with the following commands. Follow a command link for its syntax and examples.

| Command                                                 | Flag               |
| ------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------ |
| [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)                   | `--height <value>` |
| [`remotion still`](/docs/cli/still)                     | `--height <value>` |
| [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)             | `--height <value>` |
| [`remotion lambda render`](/docs/lambda/cli/render)     | `--height <value>` |
| [`remotion lambda still`](/docs/lambda/cli/still)       | `--height <value>` |
| [`remotion cloudrun render`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/render) | `--height <value>` |
| [`remotion cloudrun still`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/still)   | `--height <value>` |

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.overrideHeight(600);
```
